evidence.detail: The class owns the live Client plus exactly one current rs/j/a/d prompt; creating a prompt replaces/stores that current prompt and a() validates/submits it before clearing the reference.
Client owns this manager directly; the manager exposes the Client back to its prompt objects and is referenced by the live input/UI path rather than being an isolated helper.
The manager constructs only rs/j/a/d NativeInputPrompt objects and owns no unrelated gameplay, rendering or network state.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the client-native input prompt coordinator.

evidence.detail: The class stores prompt label text, current input text, optional prefix/suffix strings, optional Predicate<String> validation, optional Consumer<String> callback and a mode enum.
Its activation method puts Client into native input mode, selects the client input-state code, copies the prompt value into the Client input buffer and enables the input flag.
Default construction sets prompt text to 'Enter text:', empty prefix/suffix/value and TEXT mode; fluent setters configure mode/text/value/callback behavior.
The manager invokes the prompt's validation/submission method against the Client input buffer, and callback-backed validation invokes the supplied Consumer when accepted.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the client-native text/amount/username input prompt model.

evidence.detail: The enum preserves exactly three source-visible constants: TEXT, AMOUNT and USERNAME.
The enum is owned exclusively by rs/j/a/d NativeInputPrompt and is the prompt's mode field/default configuration.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 mode identity for native text, numeric amount and username input prompts.
